description: This file defines the MeetingsViewEdit class, which extends ViewEdit, and manages the display logic for editing Meeting records in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for pre-display setup (such as handling 'Held' status) and rendering the edit view with relevant JavaScript and reminders data.

classes.name: MeetingsViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to handle the editing of Meetings, including pre-display adjustments and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the preDisplay method to check for 'status' in the request, setting it to 'Held' if applicable, before calling parent method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares JSON configuration and reminders data, assigns them for the template, manages duplicate status, and calls parent display method.
